limitations: Source platform identity was not independently verified; offline metadata review only.
Source release type missing for all real rows; MB type retained as one-sided evidence.
Overlapping pairs and repeated rows are correlated; no population accuracy confidence intervals.
Labels were fixed before matcher execution but produced by a different coding agent, not an independent human annotator.
No network, track-list, release-edition or cross-source user-rating evidence used.
Pending labels are unresolved identity, not known negatives.
